plan.notes: Official University of Oregon 2026-2027 catalog, Bachelor of Science in Psychology sample Four-Year Degree Plan. The catalog states the plan is a sample; students consult advisors. Terms are Fall/Winter/Spring quarters (12 terms; UO is a quarter-system school). Declared catalog total 175-204; recorded total_credits=175 is the exact sum of transcribed credits. BS track (requires math/science emphasis vs BA language). Several slots carry catalog credit ranges; recorded at minimum.
